The institutional investor held 28,085 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.75 million, down from 33,150 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Parkside Financial Bank & Trust who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $926.95B market cap company.
